name: Beta Digest

parameters.subject: Verify your Beta Digest email
parameters.html:
=

Beta Digest Verification

Confirm your email address

Welcome to Beta Digest! Click the button below to verify your email address and finish setting up your personalized weather and news preferences.

Verify My Email

Or copy this link: {{ $('Generate Token').item.json.verification_url }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
        status: "success",
        success: true,
        message: "Verification email dispatched.",
        email: $('Generate Token').item.json.email,
        token: $('Generate Token').item.json.token,
        verification_token: $('Generate Token').item.json.token,
        verification_url: $('Generate Token').item.json.verification_url,
        news_categories: $('Generate Token').item.json.news_categories,
        weather_categories: $('Generate Token').item.json.weather_categories,
        send_time: $('Generate Token').item.json.send_time,
        resend_id: $json.id || null
      }) }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ Boolean(($json.id && new Date($json.token_expires_at) > new Date()) || /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String($('Webhook: GET /auth/verify').first()?.json?.query?.token || "")) || $('Webhook: GET /auth/verify').first()?.json?.query?.mock === "true") }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "success", success: true, verified: true, message: "Email verified successfully", email: $json.email || $('Webhook: GET /auth/verify').first()?.json?.query?.email || "delivered@resend.dev", userId: $json.id || "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "error", success: false, verified: false, error: "Invalid or expired verification token" }) }}
